name: classic
label: 经典蓝
description: 居中标题、主题色底二级标题、左边框三级标题，适合解读和资讯类长文。
source: 改写自 doocs/md 的 default 主题（packages/shared/src/configs/theme-css/default.css，WTFPL）。CSS 变量已展开为固定值，去掉了公众号不支持的写法。

vars.font: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', Arial, sans-serif

styles.container: font-family: {font}; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; color: {text}; text-align: left; word-wrap: break-word; padding: 0 4px;
styles.h1: display: table; padding: 0 1em; border-bottom: 2px solid {primary}; margin: 2em auto 1em; color: {text}; font-size: 19px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center;
styles.h2: display: table; padding: 0 0.3em; margin: 3em auto 1.5em; color: #ffffff; background: {primary}; font-size: 19px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center;
styles.h3: padding-left: 8px; border-left: 3px solid {primary}; margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: {text}; font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.2;
styles.blockquote: padding: 1em; border-left: 4px solid {primary}; border-radius: 6px; color: {text}; background: {quote_bg}; margin: 0 0 1em 0;
styles.code_inline: font-size: 90%; color: {primary}; background: #eef3f8; padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: {mono};
styles.pre: font-size: 90%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 10px 8px; background: {code_bg}; border: 1px solid {border}; padding: 0;
styles.pre_code: display: block; padding: 0.8em 1em; color: #333333; font-family: {mono}; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; overflow-x: auto;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; padding: 0.25em 0.5em; color: {text}; background: #f2f2f2; font-weight: bold; word-break: keep-all;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; padding: 0.25em 0.5em; color: {text}; word-break: keep-all;
styles.img: display: block; max-width: 100%; margin: 0.1em auto 0.5em; border-radius: 4px;
styles.hr: border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; height: 0; margin: 1.5em 0;
styles.refs_item: margin: 0.3em 8px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: {muted}; word-break: break-all;
